Package dayplanner

Class DayPlanner

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.DayPlanner
public class DayPlanner extends Object
DayPlanner is a simple activity management application that allows users to add and search for Home, School, and Other activities. Activities are stored in fixed-size arrays and can be searched using keywords and time ranges. The application uses a text-based menu system and stores all dates and times using a 24-hour clock.

1.0
